@retro-cam I'm really sorry, but I'm using that specific part of the model to create a line effect, and due to the way reverse culling works, the geometry appears larger than it normally should. This causes the mesh to behave unpredictably and makes it less stable, so it isn’t very practical to modify or repurpose in its current state.

(Additionally, creating a custom texture in Nomad Sculpt is quite challenging because many of the UV islands and model parts overlap with each other. This overlap makes it extremely difficult to paint clean details, since any change on one UV area can unintentionally affect another. The built-in UV generator also doesn’t create proportional or logically separated UVs, which further complicates the process and requires a lot of manual cleanup.)
